err.removePending: Profile mod/plugin changes are not durably saved yet. Removal was refused before refreshing or deleting; inspect the saved pre-operation choices and let MO2 finish its pending write.
err.removeThread: Mod removal must run through a Bridge worker so native refresh can finish on the Qt thread.
err.removeState: The profile or mod setup changed during removal preparation. Nothing else was removed; inspect the operation before retrying.
err.removeRefresh: Native removal refresh did not complete. Inspect the operation and current setup before retrying.
err.nativeRemove: Native mod removal did not complete: %(reason)s. Inspect the operation receipt before retrying.
